purpose: Falsifiable intent reconstruction enriched by plan concordance and topology/visibility constraints without converting agreement or access structure into historical certainty.
truth_rules: historical meaning cannot be recovered from geometry alone
contextual Old Kingdom evidence is not Khafre-specific testimony
absence of evidence is a limitation signal, not proof of impossibility
multiple linked components from one source family are not treated as independent confirmations
future-message and advanced-technology hypotheses remain testable but unestablished until direct evidence exists
no intent hypothesis can mutate geometry or evidence maturity
